name: Honey I'm Nuts
description: Coffee that's bound to drive you nuts and keep you buzzing for more! These coffees have been carefully grown and nurtured at Ratnagiri Estate in Chikmagalur, Karnataka, which has a long and faithful global following. The coffee from the Giri Patte block, sequentially fermented and washed. Whole cherries ferment anaerobically for 24 hours, then are depulped and fermented aerobically for 24 hours with Mosto (fresh mucilage must) . The coffee is then washed and slow-dried for 14 days for high-quality clarity and refined sweetness. This washed process brings out a very balanced cup with a lot of subtle flavours, bright acidity, and silky body, with flavours like yellow lemon, apricot, fig, and jaggery. Its uniqueness is bound to make it a daily "caffeine quencher" to keep you buzzing and drive you nuts with every sip. name: Fruits Bomb
description: Fruits Bomb 2026 is now available —our new-harvest release from Ratnagiri Estate, shipped straight from Karnataka through our direct-trade, sustainable relationship. Sourced from the Jeri Patte block at 1,350 MASL and yielded from the Catuai varietal, this release continues Savorworks’ flagship story that coffee enthusiasts have followed since 2020. True to its name, it’s a bomb of fruits. Only fully ripe cherries were picked, sorted, and cleaned. At 25.9 Brix, floaters were removed before sequential inoculation with lab-grown cultures and a 54-hour anaerobic fermentation in bio-reactors. Post-fermentation, the coffee went directly to raised beds and dried slowly with constant stirring for 26 days building layered fruit expression. We roast it medium-light in Delhi to preserve processing character, elevate sweetness, and keep the profile balanced with an extra-long finish. In the cup, expect grilled pineapple brightness with a touch of caramelized sweetness, umeshu-like depth from fermentation, a clear blueberry lift, and a gentle floral aroma. The body is juicy, the sweetness balanced yet complex, and the aftertaste long and wine-like, roasted for those seeking a standout experience. We highly recommend you taste it for yourself. "The journey of Fruits Bomb began during the pandemic of 2020, when the first batch was personally delivered door-to-door by our founder, marking the start of a fruity profile coffee story. Now, it’s a favorite among friends of Savorworks, with recurring orders that celebrate our commitment to quality."
